## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue if any.

## Verification

List checks actually run and their results, including relevant skipped or
unavailable checks. Use synthetic examples; omit sensitive logs and recordings.

## Risks and notices

Describe compatibility, data/migration, privacy, or delivery implications when
relevant. Identify dependency/model/asset changes and their provenance/notices.
See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
